dod_intent_evidence: One DARPA SBIR ($1,491,242, 2023, 'Side Channel Overwatch for Microelectronics') is real, but the company's own site describes an MBSE tool-integration professional-services consultancy ('we work with clients to develop custom...versions of the software', 'we build the glue') — homepage + software-development page.
what_they_do: Model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tooling and integration consultancy (OpenMETA) serving aerospace/defense clients like Airbus, with one DARPA SBIR for a lab-based microelectronics side-channel detection research tool. Note: unrelated to 'Metamorphosis Group / TMG (part of CACI)' which surfaced in search noise under a similar name.
